description: Contractual fixed monthly allowance for a monthly-rated employee, prorated like the salary by the month’s paid share (working days, EA s.20A; unpaid leave reduces it). Ordinary Wages for CPF.

references.title: CPF Act 1953 s.2(1) and First Schedule — a fixed monthly allowance is an Ordinary Wage

conversion:
const amount = get(ctx.subject, 'employment.terms.allowances.FIXED_MONTHLY.amount', 0);
return (typeof amount === 'number' ? amount : get(amount, 'value', 0)) * ctx.paid_share;

description: Contractual annual-leave uplift for a part-time employee: the contract’s amount paid in full on each run (HR keys the run’s amount; not computed from hours); needs a clear written agreement (PT Regulations reg.7). Additional Wages for CPF.

references.title: Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations reg.7; MOM, Part-time employment: leave — an hourly leave addition needs a clear contractual agreement and is prohibited at 5 days/30–34 hours

conversion:
const amount = get(ctx.subject, 'employment.terms.allowances.PT_ANNUAL_HOURLY_AW.amount', 0);
return typeof amount === 'number' ? amount : get(amount, 'value', 0);
